This ball has bailed me out of SO much in tourney play I can't even tell someone. Funny transition, dual pattern, very cliffed, and Urethane carry down all are easily handled by this ball.
Being a hybrid, it's a bit of an over under ball. Heavy oil, it still picks up and reads, then when it does see friction it makes the turn. Sounds normal, right?
Then Dry lanes, somehow it doesn't pick up early, and makes the right motion down lane where I want it.
Traffic on the lanes? Again, somehow it's not a big deal, it floats through the "dirty" areas and picks up just right.
If I get "lost" on the lanes during transition, this is the ball I can ALWAYS grab and get a grasp on what is going on.
This will be the first ball I will try to find a new in box to put on the shelf for if and when my current ball has a bad day.
If you are on the fence, this is a ball I would highly suggest to anyone.
